disposition: In (any-match over scalar and array fields) and AllIn (every listed value, empty list as V1's TrueToken) are implemented at the seam, in the TQL grammar (in-any/in-all), and pinned by a focused test covering scalar/array/absence and empty-list semantics. Only the V1 client builder spellings (ContainsAny/ContainsAll helpers) have no equivalent in the C# raw-text client.
